lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Listen, point and say

details: Listen, Point and Say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the correct image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p19 - Talk about the picture and match

details: Talk about the picture checks understanding of the concepts and draws on students’ experiences as to why we feel certain emotions. Match introduces the written words and encourages oral production of the target language.
Look for active participation, logical answers, good pencil grip, neat matching and accurate pronunciation.
